meta.name: That '70s Show: Thanksgiving
meta.description:
That '70s Show · Season 1, Episode 9 · aired 1998-11-22

Laurie brings her friend Kate home with her for Thanksgiving. Red's mother, Bernice, constantly calls, asking about Thanksgiving dinner, much to Kitty's annoyance. Red is reluctant to accept a job offer from Bob.
